designs.name: Botanical Sheer
designs.desc: A floor-length sheer gown rendered over a sculpted mini dress beneath. The botanical sunflower motif covers the full body in teal and sage — nature worn as second skin.

designs.name: Woven Stripe Gown
designs.desc: A striking bodycon silhouette built entirely from horizontal woven bands — navy, teal, olive and silver thread create rhythm across the body from neckline to floor.

designs.name: Floral Bloom Gown
designs.desc: A full-length sheer gown ablaze in amber and fuchsia tropical print. The bold botanical pattern wraps the entire silhouette — a celebration of colour and femininity at its most fearless.

designs.name: The Corset Series
designs.desc: Three sculptural corset silhouettes — each paired with a draped skirt in crimson. Rose appliqué, gold brocade and floral lace tell three distinct stories within one unified collection.
